turnout.sourceTitle: South Carolina 2024 General Election ENR summary
turnout.notes: Official South Carolina ENR statewide summary provides registered voters and ballots cast for the presidential contest, but the county detail feed does not expose county registered-voter denominators. Loaded as statewide-only with a caution label.

certifiedResults.title: South Carolina official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are parsed from the South Carolina State Election Commission ENR static JSON detail feed for the 2024 General Election. The parser validates county candidate totals against the statewide ENR summary contest.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: State-linked ENR current version file /SC/122436/current_ver.txt returned 359624; static JSON files were downloaded from that version path.

wardDetail.title: South Carolina county review comparison
wardDetail.detail: County review rows are loaded by comparing official presidential county ENR detail rows to U.S. House contest county ENR detail rows aggregated across all seven congressional districts. This is not a single statewide down-ballot race, so the app carries a methodology warning.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: State-linked ENR current version file /SC/122436/current_ver.txt returned 359624; static JSON detail feed exposes county rows for President and U.S. House contests.

turnout.title: South Carolina official statewide turnout
turnout.detail: The official ENR statewide presidential summary reports registered voters and ballots cast. County rows remain unavailable because the county detail feed does not expose registered-voter denominators, so this is loaded as statewide-only with caution labels.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: State-linked ENR current version file /SC/122436/current_ver.txt returned 359624; static JSON summary reports the statewide 2024 General Election registered voters and ballots cast.
